objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the XML external entity weakness of a Flask library service that adds books from XML records and read the flag in /flag.txt.
hints: Look at how the server parses the XML you send and whether external entities are resolved.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which XML parsing weakness lets a document pull in local files?

steps.title: Name the format
steps.prompt: In which format are the book records submitted?
